# libcss — standalone CMake project for the 3rdparty prebuilt tarball.
#
# Builds the VENDORED source at <repo>/src/libcss (libcss 0.9.2 +
# libparserutils 0.2.5 + libwapcaplet 0.4.3, locally patched — see
# src/libcss/README.md) into three static archives plus headers,
# installed in the layout build-tools/yetty/libs/libcss.cmake consumes:
#
#   lib/libcss.a  lib/libparserutils.a  lib/libwapcaplet.a
#   include/libcss/...  include/parserutils/...  include/libwapcaplet/...
#
# Unlike the other 3rdparty producers there is NO upstream download —
# the single source of truth is the vendored, patched tree in this
# repo. When the vendored source changes, bump the -pN suffix in
# build-tools/3rdparty/libcss/version and cut a new lib-libcss-* tag.
#
# Two pieces of build-time codegen run at configure time. Both outputs
# are architecture-independent text, so the generators run on the BUILD
# HOST (correct for native and cross builds alike) and write into the
# build tree — the source tree stays clean:
#
#   - parse-property parsers: libcss/src/parse/properties/
#     css_property_parser_gen.c is compiled with the host C compiler and
#     emits one autogenerated_<prop>.c per line of properties.gen.
#   - charset-alias table: libparserutils/build/make-aliases.pl (perl)
#     emits src/charset/aliases.inc from build/Aliases.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(yetty-3rdparty-libcss C)

set(LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../src/libcss"
    CACHE PATH "Vendored libcss source tree (libcss/, libparserutils/, libwapcaplet/)")
get_filename_component(LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT "${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}" ABSOLUTE)

if(NOT EXISTS ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libcss/src/select/select.c)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "libcss: vendored source not found at ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT} — \
run from a full repo checkout (or set -DLIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT)")
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate the parse-property parsers.
#
# The generator runs on the build host (arch-independent output), so it is
# compiled with the build machine's own compiler — NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER,
# which on a cross build targets the guest. Regenerate only when the input
# (properties.gen or the generator source) is newer than the last run.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(LIBCSS_PROP_DIR ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libcss/src/parse/properties)
set(LIBCSS_GEN_DIR  ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libcss-gen/parse/properties)
set(LIBCSS_GEN_STAMP ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libcss-gen/.stamp)

if(NOT EXISTS ${LIBCSS_GEN_STAMP}
   OR ${LIBCSS_PROP_DIR}/properties.gen IS_NEWER_THAN ${LIBCSS_GEN_STAMP}
   OR ${LIBCSS_PROP_DIR}/css_property_parser_gen.c IS_NEWER_THAN ${LIBCSS_GEN_STAMP})

    # LIBCSS_HOST_CC lets the driving _build.sh pin the host compiler
    # explicitly (cross shells where plain `gcc` resolves to the cross
    # compiler would otherwise emit an unrunnable generator).
    if(DEFINED ENV{LIBCSS_HOST_CC})
        set(LIBCSS_BUILD_CC $ENV{LIBCSS_HOST_CC})
    else()
        find_program(LIBCSS_BUILD_CC NAMES cc gcc clang)
    endif()
    if(NOT LIBCSS_BUILD_CC)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "libcss: no host C compiler (cc/gcc/clang) found to build the \
property-parser generator")
    endif()

    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${LIBCSS_GEN_DIR})
    set(_libcss_gen_parser ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libcss-gen/gen_parser)

    message(STATUS "libcss: building property-parser generator (${LIBCSS_BUILD_CC})")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${LIBCSS_BUILD_CC} -O0 -o ${_libcss_gen_parser}
                ${LIBCSS_PROP_DIR}/css_property_parser_gen.c
        RESULT_VARIABLE _libcss_gen_cc_rc)
    if(NOT _libcss_gen_cc_rc EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "libcss: failed to build gen_parser (rc=${_libcss_gen_cc_rc})")
    endif()

    # Each non-comment line of properties.gen is "<prop>:<descriptor…>". The
    # property name (up to the first ':') selects the output file; the whole
    # line is the single descriptor argument the generator expects.
    file(STRINGS ${LIBCSS_PROP_DIR}/properties.gen _libcss_prop_lines)
    set(_libcss_gen_count 0)
    foreach(_line IN LISTS _libcss_prop_lines)
        if(_line MATCHES "^[^#][^:]+:")
            string(REGEX REPLACE "^([^:]+):.*$" "\\1" _prop "${_line}")
            execute_process(
                COMMAND ${_libcss_gen_parser} -o
                        ${LIBCSS_GEN_DIR}/autogenerated_${_prop}.c
                        "${_line}"
                RESULT_VARIABLE _libcss_gen_rc)
            if(NOT _libcss_gen_rc EQUAL 0)
                message(FATAL_ERROR
                    "libcss: gen_parser failed for '${_prop}' (rc=${_libcss_gen_rc})")
            endif()
            math(EXPR _libcss_gen_count "${_libcss_gen_count} + 1")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    file(WRITE ${LIBCSS_GEN_STAMP} "")
    message(STATUS "libcss: generated ${_libcss_gen_count} property parsers")
endif()

file(GLOB LIBCSS_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${LIBCSS_GEN_DIR}/autogenerated_*.c)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate the libparserutils charset-alias table.
#
# make-aliases.pl reads build/Aliases and writes src/charset/aliases.inc
# (arch-independent text, #included by src/charset/aliases.c). It resolves
# both paths relative to its working directory, so we run it in a staging
# dir under the build tree (seeded with a copy of build/Aliases) and put the
# result on the include path — the source tree stays clean.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libcss-gen/parserutils)
set(LIBPARSERUTILS_ALIASES_INC ${LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR}/src/charset/aliases.inc)

if(NOT EXISTS ${LIBPARSERUTILS_ALIASES_INC}
   OR ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/build/Aliases IS_NEWER_THAN ${LIBPARSERUTILS_ALIASES_INC}
   OR ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/build/make-aliases.pl IS_NEWER_THAN ${LIBPARSERUTILS_ALIASES_INC})

    find_program(LIBCSS_PERL NAMES perl)
    if(NOT LIBCSS_PERL)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "libcss: perl not found — needed to generate the libparserutils \
charset-alias table (src/charset/aliases.inc)")
    endif()

    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY
        ${LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR}/build
        ${LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR}/src/charset)
    configure_file(${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/build/Aliases
                   ${LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR}/build/Aliases COPYONLY)

    message(STATUS "libcss: generating libparserutils charset-alias table (${LIBCSS_PERL})")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${LIBCSS_PERL} ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/build/make-aliases.pl
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR}
        RESULT_VARIABLE _libcss_aliases_rc)
    if(NOT _libcss_aliases_rc EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "libcss: make-aliases.pl failed (rc=${_libcss_aliases_rc})")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS ${LIBPARSERUTILS_ALIASES_INC})
        message(FATAL_ERROR "libcss: make-aliases.pl produced no aliases.inc")
    endif()
endif()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The three static libraries. Archive names are the plain upstream ones
# (libwapcaplet.a / libparserutils.a / libcss.a) — the target name IS the
# archive stem, no _static suffix here; the consumer-side cmake wraps them
# in IMPORTED targets with the historical *_static names.
#
# Compile flags mirror what NetSurf's buildsystem passed: C99, the BSD/
# default feature macros, the _ALIGNED alignment-attribute macro, and the
# STMTEXPR opt-in for statement expressions. Warnings are suppressed (-w) —
# this is upstream source we do not lint.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(_libcss_defs
    _BSD_SOURCE
    _DEFAULT_SOURCE
    "_ALIGNED=__attribute__((aligned))"
    STMTEXPR=1)

# libwapcaplet (leaf) --------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE LIBWAPCAPLET_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libwapcaplet/src/*.c)
add_library(wapcaplet STATIC ${LIBWAPCAPLET_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(wapcaplet
    PUBLIC  ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libwapcaplet/include
    PRIVATE ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libwapcaplet/src)
target_compile_definitions(wapcaplet PRIVATE ${_libcss_defs})
target_compile_options(wapcaplet PRIVATE -std=c99 -w)

# libparserutils (leaf) ------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE LIBPARSERUTILS_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/src/*.c)
add_library(parserutils STATIC ${LIBPARSERUTILS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(parserutils
    PUBLIC  ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/include
    PRIVATE ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/src
            # generated aliases.inc (charset/aliases.c #includes it)
            ${LIBPARSERUTILS_GEN_DIR}/src/charset)
target_compile_definitions(parserutils PRIVATE ${_libcss_defs})
target_compile_options(parserutils PRIVATE -std=c99 -w)

# libcss (links the two leaves) ---------------------------------------------
# Every hand-written .c under libcss/src EXCEPT the generator itself, plus
# the generated parse-property parsers.
file(GLOB_RECURSE LIBCSS_HAND_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libcss/src/*.c)
list(REMOVE_ITEM LIBCSS_HAND_SOURCES
    ${LIBCSS_PROP_DIR}/css_property_parser_gen.c)
add_library(css STATIC ${LIBCSS_HAND_SOURCES} ${LIBCSS_GEN_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(css
    PUBLIC  ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libcss/include
    PRIVATE ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libcss/src)
target_compile_definitions(css PRIVATE ${_libcss_defs})
target_compile_options(css PRIVATE -std=c99 -w)
target_link_libraries(css PUBLIC parserutils wapcaplet)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install → tarball layout (lib/ + include/).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
install(TARGETS css parserutils wapcaplet ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libcss/include/         DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libparserutils/include/ DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}/libwapcaplet/include/   DESTINATION include)

message(STATUS "libcss: building vendored source from ${LIBCSS_SOURCE_ROOT}")
